verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal documents ordering readers from the Dashboard, registering a reader by serial number right after unboxing, and no-code in-person acceptance, including Tap to Pay from the Dashboard mobile app. That covers the hardware-ordering-to-first-payment path. Nothing in the evidence covers account sign-up or approval, or shipping and onboarding timelines that would support taking payments the same week. Missing for 10: documented sign-up/approval flow and timing, hardware shipping/delivery timelines, independent or hands-on corroboration of a same-week time-to-first-payment.

support.subject: As a founder, I can sign up, get approved, and order hardware from the dashboard so I am taking in-person payments the same week

citations.quote: Reader management: Order, register, configure, and monitor readers from the Dashboard.
This method doesn’t require someone to physically have the reader to register it, so you can use it immediately after you unbox it.
Accept in-person payments on a compatible reader using Stripe's no-code solution.
Accept payments from the Stripe Dashboard mobile app.
